segments.an10.40:1.2: Kittāvatā nu kho, bhante, saṅgho samaggo hotī”ti?
segments.an10.40:1.3: “Idhānanda, bhikkhū adhammaṃ adhammoti dīpenti, dhammaṃ dhammoti dīpenti, avinayaṃ avinayoti dīpenti, vinayaṃ vinayoti dīpenti, abhāsitaṃ alapitaṃ tathāgatena abhāsitaṃ alapitaṃ tathāgatenāti dīpenti, bhāsitaṃ lapitaṃ tathāgatena bhāsitaṃ lapitaṃ tathāgatenāti dīpenti, anāciṇṇaṃ tathāgatena anāciṇṇaṃ tathāgatenāti dīpenti, āciṇṇaṃ tathāgatena āciṇṇaṃ tathāgatenāti dīpenti, apaññattaṃ tathāgatena apaññattaṃ tathāgatenāti dīpenti, paññattaṃ tathāgatena paññattaṃ tathāgatenāti dīpenti.
segments.an10.40:1.4: Te imehi dasahi vatthūhi na avakassanti na apakassanti na āveni kammāni karonti na āveni pātimokkhaṃ uddisanti.
segments.an10.40:1.5: Ettāvatā kho, ānanda, saṅgho samaggo hotī”ti.
segments.an10.40:2.1: “Bhinnaṃ pana, bhante, saṅghaṃ samaggaṃ katvā kiṃ so pasavatī”ti?
segments.an10.40:3.5: Saṅghaṃ samaggaṃ katvāna, kappaṃ saggamhi modatī”ti.
segments.an10.40:4.3: Sāmaṇero ca dve bhedā, ānandehi pare duveti.

lines: Yogakkhemā padhaṃsatīti yogehi khemato arahattato dhaṃsati vigacchati.
